haitian-creole--haitian-creole-everyday-.title: Haitian Creole 2: Everyday Grammar & Sentence Building
haitian-creole--haitian-creole-everyday-.description: An A1 continuation of Haitian Creole Foundations that adds article selection, contracted pronouns, deeper possession, expanded questions, health language, past and future time, and natural descriptions without reteaching Course 1.
haitian-creole--haitian-creole-everyday-.moreComingSoon: More Haitian Creole 2: Everyday Grammar & Sentence Building lessons are coming soon.

haitian-creole-everyday-grammar-1-defini.title: Choose the Right Definite Article
haitian-creole-everyday-grammar-1-defini.description: Move beyond knowing that the definite article follows the noun and learn to choose among a, la, an, lan, and nan.
outcomes: Choose a or la in source-supported noun phrases.
Choose an, lan, or nan in source-supported noun phrases.
Use article selection while listening, speaking, building, and writing familiar noun phrases.
why: Builds confidence with choose the right definite article.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

haitian-creole-everyday-grammar-2-pronou.title: Short Pronouns & Deeper Possession
haitian-creole-everyday-grammar-2-pronou.description: Extend known pronouns into short object forms and deeper possessive-pronoun patterns without reteaching Course 1 ownership or demonstratives.
outcomes: Use m, w, l, and n in source-supported object positions.
Recognize source-supported singular and plural possessive pronouns.
Distinguish object-pronoun forms from possessive-pronoun forms without reteaching known Course 1 possession patterns.
why: Builds confidence with short pronouns & deeper possession.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

haitian-creole-everyday-grammar-3-more-q.title: More Questions & Health
haitian-creole-everyday-grammar-3-more-q.description: Extend the Course 1 question toolkit and use it with body and health language.
outcomes: Use new Week 4 question forms without reteaching the Course 1 core question set.
Recognize common body-part vocabulary from the source.
Say what hurts using the source's fèmal expressions.
why: Builds confidence with more questions & health.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

haitian-creole-everyday-grammar-4-past-a.title: Talk About Past & Future
haitian-creole-everyday-grammar-4-past-a.description: Add te and pral while treating simple present and ap as known Course 1 language.
outcomes: Use te before a verb for source-supported past actions.
Use pral before a verb for source-supported future actions.
Contrast past, known present patterns, and future in short everyday statements.
why: Builds confidence with talk about past & future.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

haitian-creole-everyday-grammar-5-descri.title: Describe People & Things Naturally
haitian-creole-everyday-grammar-5-descri.description: Use Week 7 description patterns, ye, and adjectives while treating basic identity se as known.
outcomes: Recognize descriptions where English to be is not expressed in Kreyòl.
Use ye in source-supported questions and closing statements.
Use adjectives in source-supported noun phrases and descriptions.
Use selected colors, sizes, and qualities in everyday descriptions.
why: Builds confidence with describe people & things naturally.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

haitian-creole--haitian-creole-everyday-.title: Article Selection
haitian-creole--haitian-creole-everyday-.description: Choose the singular definite article from the ending sound of the noun.

haitian-creole--haitian-creole-everyday-.title: Pronouns and Possession
haitian-creole--haitian-creole-everyday-.description: Extend known pronouns and possession into shorter, more flexible sentence patterns.

haitian-creole--haitian-creole-everyday-.title: Questions and Health
haitian-creole--haitian-creole-everyday-.description: Ask for more specific information and use the questions in a simple health context.

haitian-creole--haitian-creole-everyday-.title: Past and Future
haitian-creole--haitian-creole-everyday-.description: Move familiar actions backward and forward in time.

haitian-creole--haitian-creole-everyday-.title: Descriptions
haitian-creole--haitian-creole-everyday-.description: Describe states and things with the Week 7 patterns.
bullets: Describe Without an Expressed to be
